# CopperUI tokens 0.3.0

Generated from `lib/copperui/tokens/copperui.tokens.json`; the rules behind them are in `docs/design-system.md`. Every size is a device pixel on the Kobo Libra 2 panel (1264 x 1680, 300 ppi); greys are levels 0 (black) to 255 (white) on the panel's 16-level grid.
